text: Level two, question three: a trader buys forty kilograms of rice at thirty rupees a kilogram, and sells twenty-five kilograms at thirty-six rupees a kilogram; at what price per kilogram must he sell the remaining fifteen kilograms, for a ten percent overall profit? Question four: one third of the goods, by cost, is sold at a twenty-four percent profit, and the rest at a six percent loss; find the overall result. Question five: eighty articles cost twenty rupees each; fifty are sold at twenty-five rupees each; at what price must the rest be sold to gain twenty-five percent overall?
